# Extraction-quality probe (e2e)

**Date**: 2026-06-25 · **Participants**: e2e harness

A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

> Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

> The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

This restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating
extractor has existing positioning to connect to.
